structured.feedback: The "Built for Beginners" section overpromises: several reviews say the kit is too difficult, with tiny, inadequate instructions, which the copy spins as "basic instructions... help you get started." The final "Value" section is also generic and vague, and the copy runs about 180 words, slightly under the ~200 target.
